outcomeClusters.title: Position-Time Graphs
outcomes: Read a position-time graph for position values and displacement over time.
Determine whether an object has been displaced from a description of the motion.
Calculate the velocity (slope) from a position-time graph.
Identify the appropriately shaped position-time graph given a description of the motion.

outcomeClusters.title: Kinematics Equations (Displacement & Velocity)
outcomes: Calculate the displacement of an object using the appropriate kinematics equation.
Calculate the velocity of an object using the appropriate kinematics equation.

outcomeClusters.title: Velocity-Time Graphs
outcomes: Read a velocity-time graph for velocity values and to identify constant vs. changing velocity over time.
Determine whether an object is undergoing constant velocity from a description of the motion.
Calculate the acceleration (slope) from a velocity-time graph.
Calculate the displacement (area under the curve) from a velocity-time graph.
Identify the appropriately-shaped velocity-time graph given a description of the motion.

outcomeClusters.title: Acceleration
outcomes: Identify whether an object is undergoing acceleration from a description of its motion.
Read acceleration of an object from an acceleration-time graph.
Match the action of the object to the appropriately-shaped acceleration-time graph.
Calculate the velocity (area under the curve) from an acceleration-time graph.
Calculate the acceleration of an object using the appropriate kinematics equations.

outcomeClusters.title: One-Dimensional Free Fall
outcomes: Apply the constant-acceleration model to one-dimensional free fall near Earth's surface using $|g|=9.8\ \mathrm{m/s^2}$, with the sign determined by the chosen positive direction.
Solve and explain cases in which an object is dropped, thrown downward, or thrown upward, including the velocity and acceleration at the highest point.
Represent one-dimensional free-fall motion consistently using verbal descriptions, motion graphs, and kinematics equations.

outcomeClusters.title: Vectors
outcomes: Identify vectors.
Decompose a vector into horizontal and vertical components.
Find the magnitude of a vector given the horizontal and vertical components.
Find direction of a vector given the horizontal and vertical components.

outcomeClusters.title: Right-Triangle Mathematics for Vectors
outcomes: Identify the opposite side, adjacent side, and hypotenuse relative to a specified angle in a right triangle.
Use the sine, cosine, and tangent ratios to calculate unknown sides in right triangles and apply them when decomposing vectors.
Use inverse trigonometric ratios to calculate an angle and determine vector direction with the correct quadrant or direction convention.
Apply and, when needed, review the Pythagorean theorem when reconstructing a vector's magnitude from perpendicular components.

intro:
